Lord of Aerie Peak[[Kurdran Wildhammer#Valley of Heroes Monument]] | race = Wildhammer dwarf | creature = Humanoid | level = 50 | gender = Male | affiliation = [[Wildhammer clan]] | faffiliation = [[Alliance of Lordaeron]] | occupation = Gryphon rider, High Thane of Aerie Peak | aggro = {{Aggro|1|-1}} | location = [[Aerie Peak]], [[Hinterlands]] | status = Alive }} '''Falstad Wildhammer''', also known as '''Falstad Dragonreaver''',''[[Day of the Dragon]]'', chapter 7 is the High Thane of the [[Wildhammer clan]]. He ruled the Wildhammer clan from [[Aerie Peak]] in the [[Hinterlands]] following the departure of [[Kurdran Wildhammer]] and joined his companions [[Rhonin]] and [[Vereesa Windrunner|Vereesa]] in freeing the Dragon Queen [[Alexstrasza]] from [[Grim Batol]]. ==Biography== ===Day of the Dragon=== Falstad Wildhammer was a noble gryphon rider of the [[Wildhammer clan]] of the [[Hinterlands]], commanding a small flight of such riders who patrolled the shores of [[Lordaeron]] for any hostile draconic activity after the [[Second War]]. Falstad and his comrades protected the town of [[Hasic]] from certain doom, and then transported human mage [[Rhonin]] and his companions across the [[Great Sea]] to [[Khaz Modan]]. During the journey, however, the group was ambushed and Falstad's kinsmen were killed. Nevertheless, at the incentive of [[Vereesa Windrunner]], Falstad continued to Khaz Modan. Later, with the help of a clan of hill dwarves, Falstad reached [[Grim Batol]] and fought in the final battle there to free the Red Dragon Queen [[Alexstrasza]]. ===World of Warcraft=== Now High Thane, Falstad appears as a quest giver located at [[Aerie Peak]] in the Hinterlands where he deals with the encroaching forest trolls. ==Quests== * {{questlong|Alliance|43|To The Hinterlands}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Alliance|43|Gryphon Master Talonaxe (quest)|Gryphon Master Talonaxe}} {{queststart}} * {{questlong|Alliance|45|Nat Pagle, Murloc Expert}} {{queststart}} ==Quotes== ;Gossip I am Falstad, Thane of the Wildhammer Clan. Can you smell it upon the air, the foul stench of troll lingers like a taint upon The Hinterlands.{{sic}} The trolls have been encroaching ever closer to Aerie Peak, and it is our job to stifle them at every chance that we can. So, what are you doing here, what is it the Wildhammer can do for you? ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Wildhammer, Falstad}} [[Category:Wildhammer dwarf characters]] [[Category:Quest givers]] [[Category:Hinterlands NPCs]] [[Category:Wildhammer clan]]
